text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I come across Narita Taishin in
the
central plaza.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Taishiiin! Wait up, Taishiiin!
choice_data_list: （俺、何かしたか……？）
（私、何かしちゃった……？）
choice_data_list_en: (Did I... do something...?)
(Did I do something wrong...?)

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, Ticket. Dry your tears before
you go
chasing after her.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: B-but it's my fault Taishin's—waaah!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Taishin's trainer.
choice_data_list: タイシンがどうしたんだ？
タイシンがどうしたの？
choice_data_list_en: What's wrong with Taishin?
What's wrong with Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As I'm sure you're aware, there has been
more
talk about the three of us online
lately.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, the forum that Ticket
showed us
had some hate directed at
Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was saying so many nice things
about
us. I had no idea that other stuff
was there!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah! I'm so sorry, Taishiiin!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She probably didn't know what to say...
There
were hateful comments about you
as well.
choice_data_list: じゃあさっき無視されたのは……
choice_data_list_en: Then getting ignored earlier was...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
People were saying how it's your fault
for
overworking her and that's why her
condition is so
poor.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There was even mention of how Taishin
would be
better off with another trainer
who can actually
draw out her potential.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry if I'm overstepping, but could
you please
talk with Taishin?
choice_data_list: そうだったのか……
そうだったんだ……
choice_data_list_en: So that's how it was...
So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure what she needs right now are
some words
of encouragement from you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket and Hayahide told you? Ugh, why
are they
literally always sticking their
nose in my business?
choice_data_list: 掲示板のこと聞いたよ
choice_data_list_en: I heard about the bulletin board.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Look, I'm totally fine. I'm not gonna get
stuck in
my own head and do something
reckless like
before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So you can just forget about what you
heard.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: 俺は悔しかったよ
私は悔しかったよ
choice_data_list_en: I was frustrated, honestly.
I was frustrated too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well...
choice_data_list: タイシンはどうだった？
choice_data_list_en: How did Taishin do?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hurt.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean, how else am I supposed to feel?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
But I've already decided that I'm not
gonna do
anything crazy just because I'm
mad.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm itching to do some solo training right
now...
but I won't.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm itching to do some solo training right
now...
but I won't.
choice_data_list: じゃあ代わりにゆっくり休もうか
ほどほどになら大丈夫だ！
ほどほどになら大丈夫だよ！
いや、思う存分やろう！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's take a good rest instead.
It'll be fine as long as you don't overdo it!
It'll be fine as long as you don't overdo it!
No, let's do it to our heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Making Narita Taishin train when she's
feeling
down isn't going to do us any
good.
choice_data_list: じゃあ代わりにゆっくり休もうか
ほどほどになら大丈夫だ！
ほどほどになら大丈夫だよ！
いや、思う存分やろう！
choice_data_list_en: Then let's take a good rest instead.
It'll be fine as long as you don't overdo it!
It'll be fine as long as you don't overdo it!
No, let's do it to our heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to cancel training for today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What's this?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Thanks, I guess.
choice_data_list: ホットココア。気分が落ち着くぞ
ホットココア。気分が落ち着くよ
choice_data_list_en: Hot cocoa. It'll help you relax.
Hot cocoa. It'll help you relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Narita Taishin and I take
some time to
just relax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some moderate training should help
Narita
Taishin improve.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When I tell her it's probably worse for
her health
to bottle up her stress, she
agrees.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep myself in check and be careful
not to
overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The results of her solo training are good.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to that, she's able to better

understand herself now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What?! Were you even listening to me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well... If you say so.
choice_data_list: 俺が見守ってるから大丈夫だ！
私が見守ってるから大丈夫だよ！
choice_data_list_en: I'll be watching over you, so you'll be fine!
I'll be watching over you, so don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After training...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. There's nothing like a good run to
clear the
mind.
choice_data_list: 調子よさそうだな
調子よさそうだね
choice_data_list_en: Looks like you're in good shape.
Looks like you're in good shape.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching Narita Taishin run without
worry puts
me in a better mood too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nothing. I'm gonna run another lap.
choice_data_list: どうしたタイシン
どうしたのタイシン
choice_data_list_en: What's wrong, Taishin?
What is it, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I feel better now that I've run a few
laps, but I
don't think Trainer does...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it, why not blame me
for
getting caught in the crossfire? It's
my fault those
nasty comments even
exist!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Ugh, dammit! I can't concentrate at all!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Taishin is unable to shed her
frustration,
and she remains just as
stressed as ever.
